summary: A tonewheel drawbar organ for the FM-1 that synthesises its sound from 91 shared tonewheels mixed with nine drawbars, with rotary speaker, percussion and an overdriven rock amp option.
features: Nine drawbars each for UPPER, LOWER and SOLO registrations
SINE/ORGAN tonewheels or an experimental band-limited SAWTOOTH mode
B3/LESLIE or driven ROCK/LORD amp and cabinet character
Up to 12 voices; percussion, key click, leakage, scanner vibrato
Keyboard splits, chord keys, 48 scales; rotary, delay and reverb
12 named projects; autosave optional and off by default

headings: firmware hub and stock recovery status v5.4
